parsed.rationale: Both members are unnamed extensions on `UserDefaults` within the same `Caching` package, living in two separate files (`UserDefaults+WXYC.swift` at line 15 and `DefaultsStorage.swift` at line 47). Having two extension declarations on the same type within the same package module creates a name-collision signal and scatters related `UserDefaults` behaviour across files. Consolidating both extensions into the dedicated `UserDefaults+WXYC.swift` file (or a single canonical extension file) would eliminate the collision, improve discoverability, and keep all `UserDefaults` customisation in one place within the `Caching` package.
